description: Static audit of how much a screen asks of a person. Pass `content` as HTML (best) or plain text. Reports interactive controls per screen, words, sentence length, an English reading-ease estimate, long paragraphs, missing headings, and form length, then checks WCAG 2.2 criteria that matter for cognition: 2.2.1 Timing Adjustable (meta refresh, countdown and session language), 3.3.8 Accessible Authentication Minimum (paste or autofill blocked, CAPTCHA or puzzle language), 3.3.7 Redundant Entry (confirm fields), 3.3.2 Labels or Instructions (placeholder-only fields, unexplained required fields), 1.3.5 Identify Input Purpose (missing autocomplete tokens) and 3.2.2 On Input. Count and length thresholds are conventions and are labelled so. Reads the pasted source only; nothing is rendered or run, stored or logged.

content.description: HTML of the screen, or plain text of its copy. Up to 100,000 characters on the free tier.
